evidence: The film thicknesses of the deposited films were determined by measuring the optical reflectance spectrum between wavelengths of 190 and 1100 nm and fitting a theoretical spectrum to the measured spectrum. Crystallite orientations and crystallinity of the deposited films were determined by X-ray diffraction with Cu K R radiation in a Philips MPD 1880 diffractometer. Surface morphology was studied with a Nanoscope III atomic force microscope (Digital Instruments) operated in tapping mode. Impurity levels, as well as the Y to O ratio, were measured from films deposited with (CpCH3)3Y or Cp3Y at 300 °C, by time-of-flight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA) at the Accelerator Laboratory of the University of Helsinki.
